name: What types of damage can be repaired on a sliding door screen?

mainEntity.name: What types of damage can be repaired on a sliding door screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common sliding door screen damages include tears, holes, frayed mesh, and bent frames. We can typically repair or replace damaged screen mesh, re-spline the screen into the frame, and fix minor frame alignment issues. If the frame is severely bent, corroded, or has broken components like rollers or handles, a full screen replacement might be more cost-effective. We assess the extent of the damage to determine the most suitable repair solution for your specific sliding door screen.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair tears, holes, frayed mesh, and minor frame damage. Severe damage may require full screen replacement.
